body:
Hello~

I have a question about how to convert `cupy.array` from `torch.tensor`.
Currently, I found `x = cupy.fromDlpack(torch.utils.dlpack.to_dlpack(x))` can handle this, but I'm not sure if there's a performance issue. 
Is there any faster method to do this? 

Thank you so much~
title: A question about conversion from PyTorch Tensor
